decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed scheme is considered to be acceptable and the Council is satisfied that the details provided will be suffiecient to prevent noise disturbances to nearby properties, and to protect the amenity of the approved residential properties in accordance with Policies ENV-.B1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing houses, social club and some retail premises and the comprehensive redevelopment of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail units, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private residential, key worker housing, together with improvements to surrounding access routes,  improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Underground Station and the construction of two new road links between the site and the High Street, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping  - details submitted pursuant to Condition 40 (Residential flats (sound insulate))  of planning permission reference 00616/F/P5 dated 31/7/2002
